judges: U. Durga Prasd Rao Zi J.
trial_court: Principal Senior Civil Judge, Madanapalle, H.M.O.P.No. 124 of 2017
case_name: P. Anasuya vs C. Obul Reddy
facts_of_case: The parties are P. Anasuya and C. Obul Reddy. The trial court granted dissolution of marriage under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act on the main ground that the appellant has not looked after their children. The respondent, after the decree granted by the trial court, making attempts to have second marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A contention raised by the learned counsel needs a detailed hearing.
legal_principles.held: However, having found, prima facie, force in the submission of learned counsel for petitioner, there shall be stay of operation of the order.

legal_principles.principle: A prima facie finding of force in a submission can lead to a stay.
legal_principles.held: having found, prima facie, force in the submission of learned counsel for petitioner, there shall be stay of operation of the order.

outcome.final_order: Stay of operation of the order and decretal order in H.M.O.P.No.124 of 2017 for a period of eight weeks.

use_for_drafting: seeking stay order in family court
